description: This PHP class defines an entity called 'GroupField' for use with Doctrine ORM. It maps to the 'ohrm_group_field' database table and includes properties such as id, name, groupByClause, and optional groupFieldWidget, along with their getter and setter methods.

classes.name: GroupField
classes.description: An entity class representing a group field used for ORM persistence in the OrangeHRM system.

methods.name: getId
methods.description: Returns the ID of the group field.

methods.name: setId
methods.description: Sets the ID of the group field.

methods.name: getName
methods.description: Returns the name of the group field.

methods.name: setName
methods.description: Sets the name of the group field.

methods.name: getGroupByClause
methods.description: Returns the group by clause associated with the group field.

methods.name: setGroupByClause
methods.description: Sets the group by clause for the group field.

methods.name: getGroupFieldWidget
methods.description: Returns the widget associated with the group field, if any.

methods.name: setGroupFieldWidget
methods.description: Sets the widget for the group field.
